first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Gray Racetrack
entities.identification: The gray paved road surface extending forward from the lower part of the main view, first curving left and then curving right.

entities.name: Metal Guardrail
entities.identification: The silver-gray guardrails with multiple horizontal beams extending along the curves on both sides of the road.

entities.name: Red-and-White Curb
entities.identification: The continuously arranged alternating red-and-white strip along the inside edge of the curve.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The sky area beyond the ridge-line silhouettes, with a gradient of darker and lighter blue.

entities.name: Lake Surface
entities.identification: The narrow strip of flat blue-gray water surface partially exposed beyond the guardrail on the right at the beginning of the clip.

entities.name: Distant Gray Structure
entities.identification: The partially exposed gray slab-like surface between the slopes ahead, with angular edges and a darker lower portion.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: The low, bright yellow sports car in the foreground on the left side of the main view, with dark glass, black tires, and silver wheel rims.

entities.name: Racing Interface Overlay
entities.identification: The interface composed of orange text, a horizontal rearview frame at the top, a white route map at the lower left, a circular gauge at the lower right, and green symbols.

entities.name: Slope Beside the Racetrack
entities.identification: The slopes, steep walls, and local gray-brown rock and soil beside the road and above the road surface, excluding the vegetation covering them.

entities.name: Slope and Roadside Vegetation
entities.identification: The green cover on the slopes, the rows of trees along the ridge tops, and the green ground surface on the inside of the left curve at the beginning.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The image of the nearer silver-white race car within the top rearview frame, with a dark glass area above its light-colored front.

entities.name: Vehicle D
entities.identification: The more distant, smaller image of a dark race car within the top rearview frame, with a locally light-colored upper portion.
